question: Can I open a hot shop in this building, and what occupancy is it?

nuggets.text: Zoning decides whether an industrial, business or other use is allowed on the premises.
nuggets.quote: The use of land, buildings, structures and other premises for agricultural, business, industrial, residential, flood plain and other specific uses;

nuggets.text: The local building department enforces the building code, which sets the occupancy.
nuggets.quote: Enforcement of the provisions of the Building Code for construction and rehabilitation shall be the responsibility of the local building department.

nuggets.text: One statewide building code supersedes local building codes.
nuggets.quote: Such building code shall supersede the building codes and regulations of the counties, municipalities and other political subdivisions and state agencies.

nuggets.text: A denied building permit comes with written reasons.
nuggets.quote: In the event that a local building department denies an application for the issuance of a building permit, the local building department shall provide to the applicant a written explanation detailing the reasons for which the application was denied.

notes: Occupancy classification and change of occupancy are in the Virginia Construction and Existing Building Codes (13VAC5-63), outside the statute index.
